How it works

You get a barista handle, you invent one drink using mona, ducky, or copilot, and a rubric scores it out of 5,000. Your drink joins the house menu for the rest of the event.

Everything happens on this screen. There is no terminal, no GitHub sign-in, and nothing to install.
